Use case: precise-object-edit. Make ACTUAL PRODUCTION KEY DRAWINGS for a 2D game mushroom-nest growth animation. Reference image 1 is the exact level-2 START; reference image 2 is the exact level-3 END. Produce one 1536x1024 sheet, EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows of SIX equal 512x512 cells. Transparent RGBA background, no text, grid, numbers, shadow, particles, glow or decorations. Each cell is one COMPLETE intact connected nest, generous transparent separation. Fixed camera and ground/root at cell x256,y448. Same painterly cartoon finish, thin dark green outline, salmon cap, burgundy underside, ivory cradle and exactly three coral eggs. NO small side mushroom. Cell positions read left-to-right then next row.
CELL1: level2 HALF CLOSED. Keep reference1 cradle and eggs EXACT SAME size and arrangement. Stem is shorter, cap edges bend downward and curl inward, lowering to cover the top halves of the eggs. Main cap width stays about400px; do not zoom or flatten the cap.
CELL2: level2 FULLY CLOSED. Same reference1 cradle width310px, bottom448. ONE intact rounded salmon canopy lowered like a closed umbrella, nearly touching the front rim, fully hiding vertical stem and most eggs. Front cap lip near y378, top near y225. Closed silhouette must look like this same mushroom, never a ball, bag, dome with separate panels, or roof sitting above a tall stem.
CELL3: MEDIUM GROWTH, STILL FULLY CLOSED. Same downward posture as cell2, intermediate cap width418px and cradle width325px. The cap remains down touching the cradle and no vertical neck gap opens. Growth changes natural volume, not a camera zoom. Equipment is still hidden.
CELL4: FULL ADULT level3 size, STILL FULLY CLOSED. Cap width436px, cradle width340px, root448. Main cap remains DOWN over cradle, with NO exposed vertical stem. All wood collar, supports, two vents and bellows of reference2 exist folded/tucked BEHIND the closed cap and cradle and are mostly occluded. Do not lift cap yet.
CELL5: FULL ADULT HALF OPEN. Same final adult cradle size and exactly three eggs, SAME final cap size. Cap lifts halfway toward reference2, showing the short continuous ivory stem, wood collar, attached rigid left/right vents and right bellows progressively. Keep all wood/ceramic parts attached and correctly overlapping, no floating parts, rubbery hard objects or extra apparatus.
CELL6: EXACT reference2 final adult relaxed open pose, including its short stem, three eggs, wood collar, brass lever, two cream vents and right bellows. Keep its original silhouettes, proportions, orientation and all details.
CRITICAL: cells1-2 have IDENTICAL level2 body size; cells4-6 have IDENTICAL final level3 body/cap size; ONLY cells2->3->4 grow. Cells2,3,4 MUST remain fully lowered, no cap lifting until cell5. Preserve reference likeness. No torn edges, holes, slices, disconnected wings, double outlines, blur or dissolving. These six finished drawings are animation source assets and will actually be used.

Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT this precise 1536x1024 production spritesheet, three columns by two rows. It is an EXACT SCALE AND PLACEMENT TEMPLATE, do not independently enlarge or recenter cells. Same six 512px square cells, genuine transparent background. No words, labels, borders, background, glow or particles. Keep original painting style and fine dark green outline.
Only change the poses as follows. The original ivory CRADLE and three coral EGGS must keep their existing contours, size, shading and ground contact wherever visible. Ground is local y448. Cells1-2 cradle width is310px. Cells4-6 cradle width340px. Cap width is400px in cells1-2 and436px in cells4-6. DO NOT zoom drawings to fill cells.
Cell1 top-left: HALF CLOSING level2. Lower and curl the single salmon canopy toward the cradle. Its center front lip moves from y260 DOWN to y320. The stem shortens and egg tops start to be hidden. Keep cradle unchanged.
Cell2 top-middle: FULLY CLOSED level2. Canopy front lip reaches y386 and covers the three eggs and stem like a closed umbrella, touching just behind the unchanged front ivory cradle rim. Canopy apex abouty220. One complete continuous mushroom cap, not a flat slab. Keep reference1's lower cradle exactly.
Cell3 top-right: CLOSED MEDIUM GROWTH. Keep cap fully down as in cell2, with front lip y386. Cap width418px and cradle width325px, intermediate between small and adult, bottom448. No exposed stem or machinery.
Cell4 bottom-left: CLOSED ADULT. This is EXACT full adult cradle size of template cell4; NEVER enlarge its cradle. Lower adult canopy fully to lipy386, main cap width436px. All eggs/stem/collar/vents and right bellows must be hidden BEHIND the lowered canopy and cradle. No visible machinery sticking out of the sides. Preserve adult cradle's lower folds. It MUST remain closed even though growth is complete.
Cell5 bottom-middle: HALF OPENING adult. Same full adult cradle, cap size, equipment and eggs as original template, but canopy is still halfway DOWN: center front lip at y300 rather than original220. Short stem mostly hidden, upper half of collar and vents occluded naturally by cap, three eggs revealed. Equipment remains rigid attached and unchanged, right bellows partly behind cradle. This must visibly be an intermediate pose between cell4 and cell6, not a duplicate of the final open pose.
Cell6 bottom-right: Preserve EXACT original adult neutral illustration unchanged.
These are the ACTUAL animation key drawings for user approval, not a storyboard. All silhouettes complete, single connected cap, no cutout debris or extra mushrooms. Fully transparent alpha negative space.
